paragraphs.text: Moliq is a kor soldier ally from Zendikar .

Motiq was originally an architect and civic leader in a community located in the near-vertical crags of the Makindi Trenches. Before his adventuring days, he led the construction of a new outpost for exploration and mining. One day, an avatar of retribution - a World Queller - enraged at the audacity of his fledgling community, wreaked havoc there, killing hundreds. This act taught Moliq a harsh lesson in allegiance and humility. Since then he became a shieldmate and devotes his life to getting in the way of injury that would otherwise cut into the party's tender mages and scholars.
